The screen is shown flat and straight-on and fills the whole canvas edge to edge: no monitor bezel, no browser chrome, no hands, no perspective. Design frame 1024×600 px, so everything is large, nothing is cut off at any edge and nothing scrolls.
Use the attached reference image(s) of this same app and keep the visual system IDENTICAL: page background #F4F4F2, white cards with 16px radius and a 1px hairline #E3E3E3, near-black text #1A1A1A, gray text #5D5D5D, status colors always paired with a text label (red #B42318, amber #B45309, green #247A3D, blue #0074D9, purple #5F33E1), Pretendard-like Korean sans-serif, simple 2px Lucide-like line icons. Sizes for older staff: smallest text 16px, body 18px, names and titles 22px bold, key numbers 32–40px bold, every touch target at least 52px tall. Small text (menu labels, badges, legends, chips, gray captions, phone numbers, small buttons) tends to come out too small: draw it at a full 16px, about three quarters of the height of the 22px names; shrink padding or icons, never the text. Never use an ellipsis or clipped text, and never show a half-cut card or row.
All UI text is Korean and must be rendered crisp and spelled EXACTLY as written below. No English UI labels, no lorem ipsum, no watermark, no annotations, no extra screens.
Popup: a centered white modal panel about 780×480 px with 20px radius and a soft shadow, over the parent screen, which is the 새 접수 step 3 screen of the FIRST reference image, reproduced as it is (POS rail with nine buttons, header, toolbar with step chips, panels, footer) and dimmed by a 45% black overlay (still recognizable, clearly inactive). Inside the panel: a 24px bold title at the top left with a 16px gray subtitle under it, a 48px square outlined close button with an X icon at the top right, then the body, then a bottom button row aligned right: white outlined secondary buttons and exactly ONE solid orange #FE4E10 primary button (white bold text), all 56px tall with 18px bold labels. Option buttons and steppers are 52px tall; a selected option has a near-black fill with white text. Steppers are two 52px square white outlined buttons − and + with the 24px bold quantity between them.
The second reference image is the payment popup of this app; match its panel, title, close button, option buttons and bottom button row exactly. This popup is a little larger: about 860×520 px.
Popup title "김민수 팀 · 접수 확정" with the subtitle "9/21 수령 · 2일 · 품목 7개 · 할인과 결제 수단을 고르세요".
Body: TWO equal columns with a 12px gap, each a light-gray card (#F4F4F2, 14px radius, 14px padding). LEFT card: header line with 20px bold "장비 대여" at the left and 22px bold "160,000원" at the right; a 16px gray label "할인" followed by one row of option buttons 52px tall (a selected option has a near-black fill and white text): "없음", "장비당 5,000원" (selected), "10%", "20%"; one 16px line: left gray "스키 3 · 의류 2 · 2일", right red bold "−30,000원"; a 16px gray label "결제 수단" followed by option buttons 52px tall: "카드" (selected), "현금", "계좌이체"; at the bottom of the card, above a hairline, 16px gray "받을 금액" with a 28px bold "130,000원". RIGHT card, same structure: "리프트권" "70,000원"; "할인": "없음", "20%", "25%" (selected), "27%"; line: left gray "3시간권 2매", right red bold "−17,500원"; "결제 수단": "카드", "현금" (selected), "계좌이체"; "받을 금액" "52,500원".
Under the two cards one line: left 16px gray "할인 47,500원 · 카드 130,000원 · 현금 52,500원"; right 18px gray "합계" with a 36px bold "182,500원".
Bottom button row: white outlined "취소", white outlined "나중에 수납" and the solid orange primary button "수납하고 접수 확정 · 182,500원".
